name: Kec Corporation
summary: Based in Seoul, South Korea, Kec Corporation specializes in the provision of non-memory semiconductor components. Its comprehensive product lineup features a broad range of MOSFETs, encompassing small signal, low-voltage, and high-voltage variants. The company also manufactures diverse bipolar transistors, such as those with built-in bias resistors, junction field-effect transistors (JFETs), and models adhering to USA/European specifications. Kec's diode offerings span rectifier, RF, Schottky barrier, switching, TVS, and Zener types. Its extensive integrated circuit (IC) portfolio comprises voltage regulators and detectors, shunt regulators, transistor arrays, USB power switches, operational amplifiers, comparators, DC/DC converters, telecommunication ICs, AC/DC control ICs, and photo couplers. Additionally, the company supplies specialized automotive devices, including alternator diodes and surge absorbers, alongside individual IGBT products and complete IGBT modules. These advanced semiconductor components are integral to applications across the automotive, audio-video, home appliance, information technology, LED lighting, and switching mode power supply sectors. Kec Corporation was established in 1969.
